# `RTSP`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the RTSP live stream, with stream port and ROI scale.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ; working state OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, PrintRtspState @0x158820, SendRtmpRoiRtspEvent @0x2f2030 (64-bit build); state OBSERVED (2026-10-12); CamRtxpFunc producer; port from the rtsp_port setting; "roi_scale" string absent from the 32-bit binary (finding #359); 32-bit PrintRtspState @0xd78f0 writes roi_index and port through the integer stream path, no GetRtmpRoiIndexCompat call |

Function producer (the camera stream function) plus a direct producer on stream/ROI changes. Function-state family: state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. The formatter adds roi_index (64-bit: only when the scale is close to 1, 2 or 4), roi_scale (64-bit build only, always present there) and port (both builds); the direct ROI producer sends working with View ancestry in route. The JSON event and the RTSP media are separate channels. The RTSP server on the reported port requires no authentication, has no idle timeout and needs no keepalive (OPTIONS only if one is sent); see spec/media/video.md R3c and R3d (READ). OBSERVED (2026-10-12, firmware not matched to 9.31): an RTSP working event during scenery playback; the complete packet, route, ROI members and port were not captured. Channels: imager 4700 and auxiliary 4702 (forwarded to 4700). No universal timer. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. The APK EventSocket class does not open a second event connection.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"RTSP"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name; the direct ROI producer sends working. working OBSERVED once (2026-10-12). One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ; working OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Function producer: present when state is fail, even if the stored code is 0. cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function ancestry; the direct ROI producer explicitly adds the View ancestry. May be absent on the function path. [READ] |
| `roi_index` | integer | if 64-bit: roi_scale close to 1, 2 or 4; 32-bit: emitted | - | Compatibility ROI scale index. 64-bit build: present only when roi_scale is close to 1, 2 or 4 (index 0, 1, 2); the indices for 2 and 4 are INFERRED. 32-bit build: emitted as an integer (READ). [READ] |
| `roi_scale` | number | if 64-bit build (always) | - | Continuous ROI scale. Always present on the 64-bit build; absent on the 32-bit build, so clients treat it as optional. [READ] |
| `port` | integer | no | - | RTSP media stream port from the configured RTSP port setting (default 4554), on both builds; the media itself is a separate channel. Integer on both builds (READ). [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working - Stream running (state OBSERVED; other members READ shape, values invented):

```json
{"Event":"RTSP","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":3000,"roi_index":0,"roi_scale":1.0,"port":4554,"route":["View"]}
```
